$comment: Entry schema for contributes.acpAgents (process plugins that declare the shell capability, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_acp_agents.go (install). Each entry is an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent that the AI assistant can run as a conversation backend, next to the built-in and user-configured agents. command is a bare program name found on the login PATH or ${pluginRoot}/<relative> (absolute paths are rejected); '${...}' in args and env values may only be {{lists.variables}}; there is no cwd: the agent always runs in the project root of its conversation. The agent inherits the user's full environment like the built-in agents; env adds literal values (no ${env:VAR} expansion) and env names on the contract denylist are rejected at install and at launch. Like the built-in agents it receives the user's MCP connectors and browser tools. An agent starts only after the user confirms its exact command line (once per agent spec; ${projectRoot} stays unexpanded in the fingerprint) in every approval mode; the frontend and the AI only ever name it by plugin and agent id, never by command. Connections close when the plugin is disabled, uninstalled, reloaded or fails.
description: ACP agents: Agent Client Protocol agents the AI assistant can run in the project root of a conversation after the user confirms the exact command line.

command.description: A bare program name such as "npx" or ${pluginRoot}/<relative path>. No shell runs in between: $VAR stays literal.

platforms.description: Platforms the agent works on; the agent is not listed on other platforms. Omit for all platforms.
